context:
Goal: the batch label gets set without hand work.
Problem (rule): your auto-mode entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" says a lane check PASS writes one comment, but this change makes a PASS also add a label, so either the tool changes or your text widens.
Based on (read): the merge tool's lane check and its label call (merge/merge.py, lane_lint and Host.add_label); the guard still allows the call.
Departs from: main — the allow text names one comment; this change writes a comment and a label.
home: PR #2871 (merge tool sets the batch label)

options.gain: Your allow text stays as you wrote it.
options.how: The lane takes the label write out of the lane check and sets it from a call your settings already allow, or reports back that none exists.
options.label: Keep your text; move the label (Recommended)
options.lose: More work in the lane; it may come back with no allowed route.

options.gain: The label lands with the check, with no extra call.
options.how: The lane edits the entry to say a PASS with --integration also adds one label. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Widen the text to name the label
options.lose: Your allow text covers one more write.

reply: Closed 11:12 CST Nov 13 by triage: you picked b at 11:06 CST. The lane checked your saved answer (counted n=618 choice=b) and edited that one settings.json entry in PR #2871, commit cdbb04d40. Undo: reopen this item.
short: Batch label: keep or widen allow text
title: Set the batch label without widening your auto-mode allow text
why: The allow text in the settings file is your own text.
